separation_rules.rationale: Migration execution cannot approve its own source-to-target mapping.
Cash collection and settlement execution cannot reconcile the same finance control.
Treasury settlement authorization cannot reconcile the same control.
The report formula author cannot sponsor the statutory definition.

session_sequence.scope: Appointment ratification and bounded T0 authority checks
